review: Reviewed all selected runtime deltas against the preview, complete submission-plan/options/transport modules, Pill policy/event and backend submit call sites, and changed test expectations. Pill is a large legacy module; review of its delta is not a claim that every retained line or interactive path was freshly requalified.

Pill now defaults unresolved account policy to signed-out, admits personal provider connections by their feature/lock policy, and keeps developer-only inspector controls separate. Pending server-admitted runtime provider is forwarded to the backend payload rather than replaced by the visible picker. These client choices do not grant model funding or program actions.

Existing submit options preserve explicit Realtime handoff metadata through hard-tool classification and merge. Active same-profile Physics Glyph context forces backend routing; its unchanged account-bound helper was read and retains indexed byte parity. Backend validation remains required.

Runtime fix 36 reuses one explicit Realtime handoff predicate in both submission owners. Minimal transport now preserves admitted room metadata, transcript binding and backend requirement even when speech is conceptual. A retained regression failed before this change; typed conceptual prompts with stale tool flags remain separate.

Updated the live legacy source line inventory, browser environment for the Live-controls renderer test, layout assertions for channel-owned composers/conditional control titles/expandable timeline, and extracted-helper ownership assertions. Audit expectations now use existing normalized capability names; the manual debug-answer fixture includes the required backend-observed receipt. No action admission was loosened to make tests pass.

The broad suites combine helper behavior, server-rendered markup and static source assertions. Export aliases exercise selected production modules, while static reads and unselected dependencies use canonical files. Selected canonical/export bytes are checked independently; this is not a fully assembled exported-app test.
limits: Unfrozen unpublished source proposal; fix 36 and earlier post-R380 changes remain uninstalled. No provider/model request, new read grant, room mutation or game action occurred.

These tests do not mount the complete legacy Pill, establish real account-switch/native concurrency, verify server authorization or produce a Minecraft effect. Matching installed/domain and signed ordinary-account acceptance remain open.

Static extraction/ownership assertions are maintenance checks, not standalone behavioral proof. The test import hook needed 60 seconds for the large module; no behavior timeout or product retry limit changed.
Source compilation retains external npm and separately scoped dependencies. Shared contracts, native services, remaining Console integration and public release approval remain separate.
Five intentional support-contact matches elsewhere remain for final publication review. No physics, adapter contract or certificate semantics changed.
